$comment: Canonical list of shipped HTML surfaces held to WCAG 2.1 Level AA. Paths are repository-relative. Consumed by scripts/Invoke-AccessibilityAudit.ps1 and tests/unit/Accessibility.Wcag21.Tests.ps1.

surfaces.name: Genesys Data Client (application shell)
surfaces.$comment: React renders this page's content, so the static analyzer sees only the shell. The shell still owns real requirements - page language (SC 3.1.1), document title (SC 2.4.2) and a zoomable viewport (SC 1.4.4) - and those are enforced here.
surfaces.$excludeReason: These four describe the rendered DOM, which does not exist in a SPA shell: the <main> landmark and its skip-link id, the single <h1>, and the :focus-visible indicator are all produced by React from src/, and the stylesheet is an external module rather than an inline <style> block. They are audited against the running application by apps/GenesysDataClient/tests/accessibility.mjs, which drives a browser and runs axe-core over every skin, theme and accent. Excluding them here scopes the static check to what static analysis can actually see; it does not lower the bar for the application.
